question: Who has been appointed as NITI Aayog's new Vice Chairman in May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suman Bery.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** NITI Aayog **__

 __
 
• ​​The NITI Aayog has taken the place of the **Planning Commission**, which has a legacy dating back **65 years. **For a longer time, the Planning Commission's usefulness and importance had been questioned. The alternative appears to be more appropriate and sensitive to the nation's current economic needs.
 
• **NITI Aayog Chairman – **Narendra Modi
 
• **NITI Aayog Vice-Chairman** – Shri Suman Bery is currently Vice Chairperson, NITI Aayog, in the rank and status of a Cabinet Minister. An experienced policy economist and research administrator, Mr Bery took over as NITI Aayog Vice Chairperson from 1 May 2022.
 
• **NITI Aayog Revolution**

 Aayog was established on **January 1st, 2015.** The word "NITI" signifies **morals, behaviour, instruction,** etc. in Sanskrit. However, it refers to policy in the current context, and NITI stands for **"National Institution for Transforming India.**" It is the leading institution for formulating national policy and is anticipated to support the nation's economic expansion. It aspires to build a powerful state that will aid in building a vibrant and powerful country. This aids India's emergence as a significant global economy. Both the **"Team India Hub" and the "Knowledge and Innovation Hub"** are projects of the NITI Aayog.
 
 
 
• **7 pillars of effective governance envisaged by NITI Aayog**__
 __
 
• **​**__​​​__​__Pro-people: it fulfils the aspirations of society as well as individuals
 __
 
• Pro-activity: in anticipation of and response to citizen needs
 
• Participation: involvement of the citizenry
 
• Empowering: Empowering, especially women in all aspects
 
• Inclusion of all: inclusion of all people irrespective of caste, creed, and gender
 
• Equality: Providing equal opportunity to all especially for youth
 
• Transparency: Making the government visible and responsive.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Recent news on NITI Aayog**__-
 __
 
• 
 
The Niti Aayog Governing Council's recent agenda item is the "One District, One Product Policy." At the district level, it wants to increase export.

 
 
• 
 
A research on the impact of a few Supreme Court and National Green Tribunal decisions on the Indian economy has been ordered by Niti Aayog.

 
 
• 
 
Niti Aayog is the responsible organisation for the National Action Plan for Migrant Workers, which is currently in progress.

 
 
• 
 
The NITI Aayog has developed a model Act on conclusive land titles in the expectation that states will adopt it and put it into effect. The objective is to enable transparent real estate transactions and land acquisition for infrastructure improvements, as well as to make it easier for farmers to get loans and to reduce the number of land-related lawsuits.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Goals of the NITI Aayog**__

 __
 
• 
 
**​**__the active involvement of States to create a **"national agenda"** and a framework in light of national goals.

 
 
• 
 
To continuously advance cooperative federalism through organised support channels and efforts with the States.

 
 
• 
 
To develop techniques for creating a trustworthy plan at the village level and subsequently combine these at higher tiers of government

 an economic strategy that takes national security issues into account.

 
 
• 
 
To give the societal groups that might not be able to fully benefit from economic advancement additional consideration.

 
 
• 
 
To put forth frameworks and efforts for long-term, **strategic policy and programme planning and to assess the performance of those initiatives.**

 
 
• 
 
To provide guidance, promote collaborations between** key players and national-international think tanks, as well as educational and policy research institutions.**

 
 
• 
 
**To generate knowledge, innovation, and entrepreneurial support system **through a shared community of national and international experts, etc.
